description: 白兵捉双——同时攻击马和车

intro.popup: 💡 捉双：白兵在f4，如何一步同时攻击马和车？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Fork: White's pawn is on f4. Find a move that attacks the knight and rook at once.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：f5兵叉！兵同时攻击e6马和g6车，对手不能两全。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: f5 forks the knight on e6 and rook on g6. Black cannot save both.

moves.popup: 兵推f5！同时攻击e6马和g6车——兵叉！
moves.popup_en: The pawn advances to f5, attacking the knight on e6 and rook on g6 at once. A pawn fork!
The rook captures the knight, but the position is already decided.

moves.popup: 象回吃，白方以象换车，得利。
moves.popup_en: The bishop recaptures. White has exchanged a bishop for a rook and gained material.
